Only {@link #IN_GROUP} leaves the game's own layout alone; the other two need our layout * re-applied whenever the list is redrawn (see {@code FriendGroupsPlugin#shouldRebuildOnSort}). */ public enum OfflineDisplay { IN_GROUP("In their group"), /** * Offline friends are pulled into one "Offline" section, last in the list. In grouped mode it * gets a collapsible header; with the marker off or on dots there are no headers, so they are * simply sunk to the bottom. */ SEPARATE_GROUP("Offline group"), HIDDEN("Hidden"); private final String label; OfflineDisplay(String label) { this.label = label; } @Override public String toString() { return label; } }
